_what: Every single-engine commit (tags v*-lz.*) this pipeline line does not contain by ancestry, reviewed: ported (the pipeline commits that carry it), equivalent (the pipeline already did it its own way) or n/a (the code path does not exist in the pipeline server). tests/test_pipeline_single_line_ports_audit.py fails on any commit missing here. goose Q-144: this line branched at v0.14.3-lz.2 and silently missed lz.6 until Q-143.

999d43ea656bd2f2dfd7834bf4e3dca7e2ad5a14.fixes: quantized live KV (--kv-cache-dtype int8|int4) on GatedDeltaNet hybrids
999d43ea656bd2f2dfd7834bf4e3dca7e2ad5a14.reason: scheduler.py / quantized_batch_cache.py admission and cache construction of the single engine; the pipeline server has no --kv-cache-dtype, builds its caches with stage.make_cache() and plans unquantized KV, and goose passes it no KV flag (launch.rs pipeline argv)

ce15b39ff86987ca70913c200d49804545f68d3e.fixes: a logprobs request on an MTP engine aborted the process (lazy logprob rows evaluated off the step thread)
ce15b39ff86987ca70913c200d49804545f68d3e.reason: the pipeline has no MTP path and returns no logprobs; the only values leaving its step thread are Python ints from the step's collective (_step: payload.tolist())

d1b58f6edd97ccbac084ef9f7f2bcbe204e24cbe.fixes: an unset max_tokens was filled with the serve default 32768 (goose Q-69)
d1b58f6edd97ccbac084ef9f7f2bcbe204e24cbe.reason: the pipeline chat handler never had a default: max_tokens = min(requested, budget) if requested else budget, budget = the planned context less the counted prompt

8a15af57591611b6f6a592605d9aba097dfa4878.fixes: the transient tail may end the last tool message (goose Q-94)
8a15af57591611b6f6a592605d9aba097dfa4878.reason: goose Q-143: cherry-picked, and /v1/models declares rapid_mlx_transient_tail_on_tool

c4f11b7a62fc8d9df673bf41e5b4533e954f27be.fixes: the XML tool-call skeleton guard (goose Q-85)
c4f11b7a62fc8d9df673bf41e5b4533e954f27be.reason: goose Q-144: cherry-picked; the last rank (the one that samples) runs it on rows whose plan says tools

d159b1141807f8f68c184d8065488ff5e553eca0.fixes: the XML close guard starts at the close marker itself (goose Q-85)

da83e3c208df0188a379c84b64079181e1acb195.fixes: the XML close guard arms through mlx-lm's TokenizerWrapper (goose Q-85)
da83e3c208df0188a379c84b64079181e1acb195.reason: goose Q-144: cherry-picked; the pipeline's last rank loads its tokenizer with mlx_lm.utils.load_tokenizer, i.e. that wrapper

eb9ed506d329a8f73a7e3d1fe0079983ab78219c.fixes: the XML close guard holds the function close too, and never forces a call (goose Q-85)

5fc8b99317a38b5e694d88c275f90ccbb0585fe1.fixes: a prefix-cache entry owns exactly the bytes it is charged for (goose Q-110)
5fc8b99317a38b5e694d88c275f90ccbb0585fe1.reason: goose Q-144: adapted, not cherry-picked — the single engine's memory_cache/hybrid_state_checkpoints are not on the pipeline path; the pipeline's own _PrefixStore.put held the QSA index cache's raw-ring view (1.346x charged at 512-token chunks, CPU) and now owns its arrays (1.025x)

5a5a76598339dec1c215228be05dd86313cab94f.fixes: serve answers to every name of its model — --served-model-alias (goose Q-131)
5a5a76598339dec1c215228be05dd86313cab94f.reason: the pipeline server's own --served-model-alias landed the same day for the same finding
